description: Permanently removes a specified attachment from a Trello card; this action is irreversible and requires that both the card and the attachment exist.

idAttachment.description: The ID of the attachment to be deleted from the card. This is a unique identifier for the attachment.
idAttachment.title: Id Attachment

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the card from which the attachment will be deleted. Card IDs can be short (e.g., 'FY2OWrnc') or long (e.g., '571d07b591c8b68aeb4f6acc').
idCard.title: Id Card

name: delete_card_attachment

DeleteCardAttachmentResponse.description: Response schema for `DeleteCardAttachment`. Returns an empty response body with HTTP 200 OK status code when the attachment is successfully deleted.
DeleteCardAttachmentResponse.title: DeleteCardAttachmentResponse
